description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by imp-0004. AGSC-03-19 and AGSC-03-20: foreign link names are mapped on import and never added to the vocabulary — refines becomes narrower, conflicts-with becomes excludes, blockedBy becomes blocked-by and tests becomes verifies. Derivation over one OKF document with those four keys: the mapped frontmatter carries the four Link keys with the same targets, none of the four foreign spellings survives, and each mapping is reported once as the AGSC-E506 warning of AGSC-01-22 (a foreign construct carried across with a note), so four such warnings are expected for the links and no error; the document declares a type, a title and prov, so no other AGSC-E506 is raised and the case isolates the mapping.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
reason: Withdrawn at rc.6 (2026-09-25) and superseded by imp-0004. The input record declares no licence, so AGSC-01-22 as amended at rc.6 obliges status: draft and one more AGSC-E506, while the case expects exactly four warnings; the conformance runner had to take the source licence as established for the case to pass. imp-0004 is the same case with license: CC0-1.0 in the input frontmatter, so the mapping is isolated by the input and not by the runner.
